title: State Rejection Codes and the Correction Window, Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
When an ordering state rejects a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate, the rejection code on the state's response decides who supplies the correction, and the correction window sets how long corrected information may take to arrive.

## Reference card (identical on all six certificates)

| Item | Cardinal SR-22 Owner / Owner-Operator | Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner / Owner-Operator | Cardinal FR-44 Owner / Owner-Operator |
|---|---|---|---|
| Correction window (calendar days after the state's rejection) | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Codes the customer must correct | name mismatch; license number mismatch; date of birth mismatch; case not found | same | same |
| Codes Cardinal corrects without the customer | policy number format; form type mismatch | same | same |

## Code groups

**Corrected by the customer.**
- *Name mismatch* — the name on the certificate does not match the state's record.
- *License number mismatch* — the license number does not match.
- *Date of birth mismatch* — the date of birth does not match.
- *Case not found* — the state could not find the case.

**Corrected by Cardinal.**
- *Policy number format* — the policy number is not in the form the state accepts.
- *Form type mismatch* — the form filed is not the form the state expects.

## Quick questions

**Is the correction window counted in business days?** No. It is 10 calendar days on every certificate.

**Does the customer supply anything for a form type mismatch?** No. Form type mismatch and policy number format are on Cardinal's list.
